mechanism: Before implementing the full H-B hierarchy, test whether one-process temporal reachability envelopes leave enough root-error budget to keep a nontrivial part of an exact optimal pair-tree frontier unresolved.
omitted_computation: Values V_t(i,j) replaced at a frontier by a reachability lower envelope computed without inspecting cross-process continuation matrices.
assumptions: The corrected finite k-window target, costs and two-sided process laws are exactly those frozen in objective.json, frozen_design.json and frozen_design_amendment_1.json
This is a registered replication after lane C disclosed a post-hoc diagnostic; it is not a blind preregistration
The original H-B 10 percent threshold was fixed before lane C produced its diagnostic
Exact optimal occupation is used only to create an optimistic mechanism audit and is unavailable to a deployable candidate
lemma_or_invariant: For a cut F of the pair tree, monotonicity of the Bellman recursion gives R-L_root at least sum_{z in F} mu_star(z)(V(z)-E_lo(z)). Reachability intervals also give E_lo<=V<=E_hi pointwise. Therefore sorting frontier mass by local slack gives an optimistic upper bound on mass that can remain at the envelope within the root budget.

nearest_prior_art.overlap: Hierarchical transport partitions and certified omission of fine constraints
nearest_prior_art.remaining_question: Whether conditional temporal envelopes are tight enough before static multiscale transport is applied

nearest_prior_art.overlap: Backward nested transport on quantized path trees
nearest_prior_art.remaining_question: Whether a pair-tree frontier can remain unresolved at a 0.5 percent root certificate

prediction: In every one of the 12 frozen k=1 process x cost x delta groups, the two-seed median has at least one layer t<=T-2 where at least 10 percent of exact optimal occupation can remain at E_lo within epsilon*R, and the same remains true after pairs incident to out-degree-one states are excluded.
falsification_rule: Any envelope containment or occupation-flow violation is implementation_invalid. Failure of the registered occupation prediction in any group is mechanism_headroom_falsified and keeps H-B at revise. It is NOT by itself performance_prediction_falsified because occupation mass is not the original distinct-entry metric. H-B may be called performance_prediction_falsified from this probe only if an explicitly reported optimistic upper bound on omittable distinct entries is below 10 percent under a frontier class proven to contain every H-B execution.

probe.oracle: Independent numerical backward LP retaining V tables and optimal conditional plans; reference values are used only by this non-deployable falsification probe
probe.cost_accounting: Report model construction, exact-reference time, reachability preprocessing, envelope queries, number of local LPs, state-pair entries, occupation support, and total wall time. No timing number is a candidate or SOTA result.
probe.rng_convention: For each task seed, numpy SeedSequence(seed).spawn(2) creates independent side-A and side-B generators. The same generated paths are reused across both costs and all methods.
probe.stopping: Run all 12 k=1 groups and both seeds. k=2 is not run in C1 because failure at a required k=1 group is sufficient to reject this prerequisite prediction; this does not narrow any final candidate benchmark.

breadth_challenge: Both costs, both frozen process contrasts and all three required deltas are tested. C1 is a short-horizon necessary-mechanism screen and cannot replace T=50 or k=2 validation for a surviving algorithm.
ablation: Report results with all occupied pairs and after removing any pair whose left or right state has out-degree one; also report zero-slack fractions and an optimistic entry-count bound so sample sparsity and metric mismatch are visible.
unresolved_objections: The frontier accumulation inequality is only a necessary condition and can be loose
A low servable occupation fraction does not imply a low omittable entry fraction
Mixed-depth adaptive frontiers are not characterized by this first probe
prior_data_disclosed: Lane C reported a post-hoc k=1 diagnostic before this record: layer-1 occupation-weighted gap around 190-196 times the root budget and zero servable mass in its reconstruction. This run tests reproducibility under the exact synced design and independently written code.
